rationale: The tool lets users create and maintain websites and stores through a WYSIWYG editor, with automatic cross-device/browser site generation and SEO tools—conventional site-building functions.
evidence_spans: IM Creator is a cloud-based web development solution that allows individuals and businesses to create and maintain online stores, blogs, and HTML5 websites without writing code. It uses the WYSIWYG principle, and automatically generates cross-device, cross-browser compatible websites with built-in SEO tools.
